lines.text: Every part of Nigeria's coat of arms means something.
The black shield stands for Nigeria's fertile soil.
The white Y shape is the Niger and Benue rivers, meeting.
The red eagle on top stands for strength.
The two white horses stand for dignity.
And at the bottom, the motto: Unity and Faith, Peace and Progress.
